nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Run manually or trigger after MSC-ALGO completes

nodes.name: Discover Brands
nodes.notes: AUTO-DISCOVERY: Scans Output/ for MSC-ALGO results. No manual brand config — always synced.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Phase 1: UNIVERSAL config resolver. Reads brand from upstream, validates paths exist.

nodes.name: Read Growth CSV
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Parse CSV into individual items. Each item = one product row + config metadata

nodes.name: Filter Actionable
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Only process products marked as actionable by MSC-ALGO

nodes.name: Split In Batches
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Process 5 products at a time (rate-limit friendly for Perplexity)

nodes.name: Check Cache
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Hash-based cache check. Sets _cacheHit=true/false for routing

nodes.name: Cache Router
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Route cached products to skip harvesting

nodes.name: Collect Cached
nodes.notes: Phase 1: Cached products pass through unchanged

nodes.name: Perplexity: Reviews
nodes.notes: Phase 2: Stream 1 — Product-specific reviews via Perplexity

nodes.name: Perplexity: Category
nodes.notes: Phase 2: Stream 2 — Category-level psychology via Perplexity

nodes.name: Merge Harvest
nodes.notes: Phase 2: Combine product reviews + category insights into single item

nodes.name: Extract Harvest Data
nodes.notes: Phase 2: Parse Perplexity JSON responses into text fields

nodes.name: Claude: Analyze
nodes.notes: Phase 3: Claude Sonnet synthesizes harvest data into 10 psychographic columns

nodes.name: Parse Analysis
nodes.notes: Phase 3: Parse Claude JSON, apply quality gate (≥3 fields), merge into product row

nodes.name: Update Cache
nodes.notes: Phase 3: Write fresh results to cache for future runs

nodes.name: Merge All Results
nodes.notes: Phase 4: Combine cached + freshly enriched products

nodes.name: Write Enriched CSV
nodes.notes: Phase 4: Write final CSV (34 quant + 10 qual columns). Summary stats in output.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Phase 4: Catches any node failure

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: Phase 4: Log error details for debugging
